scene_text.text: Three-quarter-length candid photograph of him caught mid-step on a sandy beach path, side-on with his chest facing picture-left and his left leg forward, a white surfboard held against his far side. His face is turned about 30 degrees toward picture-left, glancing back over his left shoulder, chin level, eyes into the lens, a slight closed-mouth smirk lifting the mouth corner at picture-right. His left forearm lies level across his stomach, the hand holding the board's tail at its lower pink fin; a blue-green leash loops below the tail and a soft black jacket hangs over the rail behind his hips. He wears knee-length navy board shorts with a light-grey panel, a white stripe and a black drawstring waistband, with his dark curly hair, full dark beard, janeu (a thin white thread from his left shoulder across his chest) and a silver chain. Leafy coastal trees arch over grassy sand banks, a weathered wooden post and thin white rope fence lines. Soft bright daylight from a hazy sky, dappled sun on the sand. Camera at shoulder height, two metres away, phone 1x. Handheld phone grain, a slight tilt, the board's nose cut by the right edge. Vertical 3:4 frame.
